rows.text: You probably don't remember me. No, that's too rude of me to say, I'm not worthy...
rows.speaker: Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: Of course I remember you, Mr. Loka.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: This is... unbelievable...
rows.speaker: Loka of the Bloodhound Family

rows.text: I don't spend a lot of time in Penacony, and have even fewer chances to help out the Harmony. If I'm willing to go, I always make sure to get to know everyone beforehand...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: After all, Family greetings can't be mere pleasantries. They must be heartfelt blessings for each and every family member.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Miss Robin... you're absolutely dazzling...
rows.speaker: Loka of the Bloodhound Family

rows.text: By the way, what brings you to Dream's Edge? Do you have anything you need from us?
rows.speaker: Loka of the Bloodhound Family

rows.text: You seem to know a lot about my past...
Pardon me, but have you seen two tourists? They both have gray hair, and one of them... is a young lady wearing a hair clip.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: You're looking for someone? I don't really recall seeing them... but I can keep an eye out for you if you'd like?
rows.speaker: Loka of the Bloodhound Family

rows.text: Oh, well...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Don't bother.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: M—Mr. Sunday? What are you doing here...
rows.speaker: Loka of the Bloodhound Family

rows.text: I heard someone's up to no good, so I came to check things out myself.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Huh? I...
rows.speaker: Loka of the Bloodhound Family

rows.text: No worries. It's okay if {F#s}he forgot. {M#He's}{F#She's} always preferred the latest new thing... Maybe {F#s}he picked up that bad habit from me.
rows.speaker: The Elegant Nameless

rows.text: Just kidding, don't be so tense. Robin hasn't been home for a while, so I brought her here specifically to look around and reminisce about her childhood days.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Understood.
rows.speaker: Loka of the Bloodhound Family

rows.text: There's a construction site ahead, so we won't go any further. Goodbye.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Thanks a lot, Mr. Loka.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I couldn't speak freely earlier. Robin, why did you come here?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Like you said, I'm here to reminisce about old times.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: What about you? What brings you here?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Tracking down criminals is my duty.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: And you, my dear sister... you've always been this stubborn, and in times like these, I wish you never had this trait.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: You're still investigating on your own, ignoring what I said?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Yeah. I can't stop thinking of "death," so I followed some people all the way here.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: After all, I witnessed that horrific scene at the Dewlight Pavilion with my own eyes. I can't let you bear this burden alone.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Oh? So you saw them... those Family members who were in the sweet dream, yet "Death" took them away.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Hmm. I only saw documents strewn on the table-top. If my brother had even an ounce of energy left, he would never have tolerated such a disorganized sight.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Just like now, if it weren't for getting the truth out of you...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Strictly speaking, these are my memories. I can't presume to speak for others.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: You had just arrived in Penacony at that time and were checking in at the hotel.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: By now, you should know that "memories" are both precious and dangerous. I must be extremely careful in allowing all the details of the past to come to the surface.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Relax... The dust is being swept aside, speck by speck. Look...
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: I'm afraid I can't tell you directly. Whether intentional or not, putting memories into words would only distort them.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: "Is this... what dreams are?"
"I can't see anything. Can't hear anything. Nothing exists except darkness."
"I don't understand..."
"Why do people long for this darkness?"
I absolutely won't tolerate your arrogant and disrespectful facade.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: You know what they say. Robins will fight tooth and nail to protect their territory, even at the cost of their own lives. Looks like that name suits you pretty well.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Oh, right on schedule. Gray Hair should be wrapping up soon! Miss Sparkle, time to head to the next scene!
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Let's roll!
rows.speaker: Sampo (?)

rows.text: ...Oh my, I thought I could fool your eyes at the edge of the Dreamscape. But I guess there's no hiding from you on your home turf.
rows.speaker: Sampo (?)

rows.text: What, you want to settle the score with me for messing with your people? Why don't we sit down and have a chat? You seem like a patient one to me.
rows.speaker: Sampo (?)

rows.text: So, tell me... what exactly do you want to take from me?
rows.speaker: Sampo (?)

rows.text: How are you feeling? Need to take a break?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: The Fool killed her, and the crime scene you witnessed was staged by her.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Of course, there's no such thing as true death on Penacony. For Robin, this is just a minor setback.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: That stage is called the "sweet dream." Everyone upon it carries their own desires, striving to see them fulfilled. Yet when those desires intertwine and collide, the sparks that fly are dazzling, and clarity itself becomes obscured.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Before we continue, I have one more question. We've spent some time together, so at this moment, how do you feel about me?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: How... delightful. A pity, though, because that's not the kind of feeling I was thinking about.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: How much are you willing to trust me?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: I made a promise with {M#him.}{F#her.} Our reunion is right before us. I have no reason not to give it my all.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Even if {F#s}he's already forgotten it?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: But I won't forget.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: No matter how this story ends, I want it to... begin with a smile.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: In the "future" that Elio foresaw, we never had an "ending". But I still have the chance...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: To wrestle back from fate the right to have a "beginning."
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: As a matter of fact, I've appeared in your "memories" before. And similarly, it was related to Penacony.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: That's exactly what I like to hear.... let's continue then.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: By my measure... it's not bad at all. But talk is cheap, so let's keep going. When the time comes, if you still can't trust me, I'll give you plenty of time... I can take whatever criticism comes my way.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Let's follow that train of thought and delve deeper...
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Even I don't know about your experiences in Dream's Edge. When I asked Firefly about it, she declined to give an answer.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: But judging from her expression, I believe... it must have been a beautiful and unforgettable time that belonged to just the two of you.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: And Sparkle wasn't just here for fun. She's in cahoots with the Stellaron Hunters.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: She disguised herself as someone from your past, using every means possible to hint at the truth of the dreamscape. In the end, she simply sent you both deep into the dreamscape.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: What a kind-hearted Fool she was. Thanks to her, you and Firefly managed to uncover a piece of Watchmaker Mikhail's past.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: And the dangers that lurk within.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: A Memory Zone Meme, "Something Unto Death." At least back then, you mistakenly thought it was dangerous.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: With the help of a... let's say "graceful" Memokeeper lady, you managed to escape from there. But in the rush, you and Firefly got separated. And her experiences afterward might differ from what you remember.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: I was there at that time too.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: ...Don't worry, I've got you. How are you feeling?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Passing through memoria so suddenly always leaves you in a daze. That Memokeeper had ulterior motives. She could have sent all of you away, but deliberately kept you behind.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: What happened just now?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: It's a Memory Zone Meme. Some Penaconian legends mentioned it and called it "Death." I caught something unusual, but couldn't get a clear look at it.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: But I saw it. In that instant before it was about to strike, a reflection of another dreamscape appeared in its pupils. It was somewhat similar to the Twelve Hours, yet the atmosphere was completely different.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: What if "Death" doesn't exist in sweet dreams... or so they say. But what if that's not a lie? Perhaps death is just sinking into a deeper dreamscape.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Is this Firefly's memory?
Too bad, a nosy Memokeeper had to show up. Next time we meet, leave it to me. I'll... give her an experience she won't soon forget.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: When did this happen?
Every time you say that, it's always you who seems to be having fun. This time, try not to go overboard.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Why did you stop me?
I can't sense them anymore. I'm afraid they must have gone back to reality.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: But I still can't recall...
...Hold on.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Tell me what happened to Firefly.
Still no good. I can't get in touch with Silver Wolf in the Primordial Dreamscape.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: It's that Memory Zone Meme. Be careful.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: What's that!? Firefly, let's go and check it out.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: From the traces nearby, it was "Death's" doing. But they... did they really die?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: No, your conjecture is right. It's just that these birds weren't welcome in another dreamscape.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: You've seen them before?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Yes, but that's what makes this so intriguing. The outcome of the battle was the complete opposite of what I expected.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: That reminds me, there's something important I still haven't asked you yet...
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Would you like to die together with me?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: T—Today? Not really.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I just love catching you off guard like that. It's adorable.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Then... take a few steps back. I have a few conjectures. There might be some risk... If anything happens, don't worry about me.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: The beginning of the sleepless night, the moment you first entered the dream.
What are you...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Just as I thought.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: So, what happened?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: These ravens are the incarnation of the Dreammaster Gopher Wood, that omnipotent being in the sweet dream. In front of him, even "Death" has no strength to resist.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: The power I just released should have been enough for him to notice and deliver a fatal blow, yet here we are, completely unharmed.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: ...You know, you're quite similar to Blade sometimes. I mean... when you're staring death in the face.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: It's not relief I feel. I'm savoring... a once-in-a-lifetime thrill.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: If only it was just once for me too.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: But was it really him? If I remember correctly, the Dreammaster's body was burned to ashes in a riot long ago, and he can now only sustain his life within the sweet dream.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Not only that, over the long passage of time, he has merged himself with every inch of Penacony's land.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: The title "Dreammaster" doesn't mean he merely controls the dreamscape. Rather, it means he has already turned the dreamscape itself into his second body.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: In extreme cases, he could probably burn all of Penacony to the ground... Though hopefully he wouldn't have the heart to do it.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: We better act fast.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Easy now, we're safe for the time being. Maybe it's not that he doesn't want to act against us, but rather that he can't. At least not yet?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Lately, Gopher Wood has been claiming to be ill, never appearing in the Twelve Hours. Yet just recently, he buried his darkest crime deep within the dreamscape.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: So you're saying that burying this crime took a heavy toll on him, leaving a flaw in his supposed omniscience and omnipotence... That does sound plausible. Could it have something to do with the Watchmaker's Legacy?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I don't think so. After all, that secret was branded as "the darkest." And perhaps... the "Legacy" is not one alone. Only by seeing it for ourselves can we know.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: A mistake anyone could make... Setting up layer upon layer of security around a secret only ends up exposing its flaws.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Why don't we give it a shot, and build up some experience dealing with memes?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: There won't be any new experiences. I'll activate Fyrefly Type-IV and end this quickly.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: What a pity. I would've much preferred to see you in a pinch, so you'd have to rely on me all the more.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: When it comes to this, you're the expert. Yet I'd always imagined that calling upon that power would make you... profoundly melancholic.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: ...I'm not now, and never will be.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Is this it? An entrance?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: It only looks like an entrance. That crack doesn't lead anywhere. It's a lock of memories, and the key is a Light Cone carrying specific memories.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Clearly, Gopher Wood had help from a Memokeeper, and since that Light Cone isn't in our hands, I fear we'll be returning empty-handed.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Is there really no other way?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: We could try our luck. Perhaps the Memokeeper helping Gopher Wood shares the same habits as me.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: I'll take a look, but don't get your hopes up.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: ...Pretty careless indeed, just like an old friend of mine.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Looks like we're in luck. We've found one of their "contingencies."
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Do you have memories like that? A moment in time you never want to forget, one that you find yourself reliving over and over again.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Of course... and more than just one.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: What a shame.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Don't take it to heart, I'm just imitating those annoying Memokeepers. In their view, the more a memory is recalled, the more likely it is to become distorted beyond recognition.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Each time you recall a memory, you risk distorting its true face. That's how they justify the necessity of Light Cones. How tragic. They never understood the truth: The more eternal a thing, the more it stirs the desire to destroy it.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: But they weren't wrong about the present situation. Even if Gopher Wood were to come in person, he'd need to bring a specific Light Cone. His own memories can no longer be trusted.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: That's exactly why we have a "contingency" plan right in front of us.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: But I haven't seen anything since just now...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Oh... sorry.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Inside here, there must be some kind of "gentle trigger" that would help him recover his memories before they are subjected to distortion.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: But for us, that's probably meaningless. Whatever triggers his memories would just seem bizarre and random to us.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Still, let's go take a look inside. We might pick up some clues at least.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: That's right. Go ahead. Every action brings joy...
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: And a "price" to pay.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: How can this be...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: AR... 214... Is that really you...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: You... don't have to force yourself. I can take care of it.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: No, it's okay...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Was it her that you saw when infiltrating Penacony?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Yes, I saw her fighting off the Swarm. But it was just memoria, and it vanished quickly. Silver Wolf mentioned that Penacony had also faced a Swarm invasion before. I kept telling myself that she was just passing by and lending a helping hand.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: And after everything was over, she had already left safe and sound.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: So this time, do you still want to know the answer?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Would it be any different? I really want you to tell me... that this is not real. It's just memoria.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: But thinking about it calmly, nothing can change it. A memory... is ultimately something that's already happened.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...You're more composed than I expected.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: They split up?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I wish I wasn't like this.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: She and I... we could be called friends. I wish I could just break down and cry for her, like any normal person would, to mourn her loss.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: But what surfaced in my mind was that one sentence...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: This is our predestined fate, and one day, I too shall meet the same end.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: "One day."
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Hmm, not today. Though it's already too late, there are still other things I can do for her.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Maybe you should calm down first. Unfortunately, this isn't memoria, but a real Glamoth Knight. Clearly, Penacony was her final destination.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: I'm surprised she made it to Penacony at all.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Oh? The Glamoth Regulations? She broke those prohibitions?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Worse than that, she was the first and only "deserter" of the Glamoth Iron Cavalry. The Empire hadn't fallen yet, but she didn't want to accept a fate of dying in battle, so she left on her own. She said... she wanted to choose how she would die.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: We had a brief farewell... but I didn't stop her, I couldn't... Leaving the Glamoth Empire itself would quickly drain her life away.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: If we can't change the outcome, why should I stop her from making her own choice?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Quickly drain her life away... oh, Entropy Loss Syndrome?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Yes, just like me. "Leaving the cockpit without permission is strictly prohibited. Surviving knights must actively return to formation." These aren't just military regulations. They're the terms of our survival.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: When not piloting the Fyrefly Type IV, I must stay in the cryosleep pod. Otherwise, my Entropy Loss Syndrome will only get worse.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Oh.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: So, have you figured out the reason yet?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: When [Trailblazer] and Kafka found me, I had just finished my duties as a Glamoth Knight...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...my final battle as a Glamoth Knight.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: The Empire fell, and all restrictions vanished. For the first time, green flames ignited upon my body... and for the first time, I touched the true Path power that the Glamoth knights wield.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: That's when I realized... Entropy Loss Syndrome is a death called {RUBY_B#Propagation}living{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: The Propagation? That's the true source of the Glamoth Iron Cavalry's power?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Yes, I've seen it happen. When the Swarm King dies, the Swarm completely loses its vitality and falls into silence.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Just like Glamoth's Iron Cavalry, they weren't given a sense of self. The moment they stray from the "hive," they're already dead. The same goes for Entropy Loss Syndrome.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Could you help me take her away? I don't want to leave her here alone.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: After all this is over, I want to give her a proper burial, just like any normal person.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I'm happy to help.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: She wanted to escape her fate, but in the end, she died fighting against the Swarm in Penacony. The detestable thing about destiny is that it brooks no defiance.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Do you know her name?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: When we parted, she had no name, just like me. But I hope... by the time she leaves this world, she will have found both a name and a purpose for her life.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Why did Gopher Wood leave her here? No matter how much I think about it, everything he's scheming couldn't possibly be connected to the Propagation.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: How deeply is your past intertwined with this place?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: It's not clear yet, but obviously, she had multiple fatal wounds on her body... she definitely didn't die from entropy loss.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Before we left, Kafka told me: in her view, dreams are inherently a "convergence of the past." It's the same for everyone, no matter how much you want to avoid it, no matter what you're seeking, you can't avoid it. Perhaps she was right.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: However, the Dreammaster's weakness has also given us an opportunity.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Good, now then...
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Oh? Good news. It seems like we've got a few intruders in this dreamscape. Looks like Silver Wolf can still pick up signals from here after all.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: That was fast...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Must be that Memokeeper's guidance. Either she's lost her sense of restraint, or... got something nasty up her sleeve.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Let's go check it out.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: You... aren't hiding anything, are you?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Hold on, there's a troublesome stranger here.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: She looks familiar, she's...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Oh? You don't know? Setting allegiances aside, she's much more dangerous than the Dreammaster.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: When facing an Emanator who walks in the Nihility, we must always tread carefully, no matter when or where.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: An Emanator of the Nihility!? Was she ever mentioned in the "script"?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: No, if it weren't for "my father's death," I wouldn't have known about this either.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Your arrival is timely. This Dreamscape is fraught with danger. Since our destination is the same, how about we join forces?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I can protect you from harm, but in the Memory Zone, I'll need assistance from the Memokeeper as well. And... if we run into The Family, it wouldn't hurt to have one more person to explain the situation.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Absolutely not. We need to keep her away from [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I can sense it. "Death" has cast its shadow once again. It's close, and unless things change, they'll cross its path before long.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: But Black Swan is still here, with unknown intentions. If she chooses to twist the truth, you won't be able to convince the others. Here, a Memokeeper's word carries more weight.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: No need to rush things. There's still time to reveal the truth later.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Absolutely not! Have you forgotten? As a Stellaron Hunter, I have a "Zero-Point Mission," one that must be completed at any cost—
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: If there's even the slightest chance that Acheron might draw her blade, I cannot let [Trailblazer] be there.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Oh, I thought you wouldn't care. Haven't you had enough of sacrificing yourself for duty?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: My dream... was destined to shatter from the start, but for them, it's still not time to wake up.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Can I ask you for one more thing? There might be a way to have the best of both worlds, but I need to find "Death" before them.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: That's not hard. It's still lingering in this Domain, but... a win-win solution?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: I don't know for sure, but it's worth a shot. Maybe it's not always hostile, and even if it is, once I activate "Fyrefly Type IV," I can quickly subdue it. But if we're dealing with the worst-case scenario...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Elio once said that I would face death three times in Penacony. And for this "first death"... I want to decide how it comes.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I just hope that reunion a moment ago didn't rattle you.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Go on ahead. I've burned a hole through the memoria that'll take you straight to the meme. Better hurry though, it might not stick around in one place for long.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Got it, thank you.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: There's no sign of anything... could it have already left?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Nothing strange here either...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Wait... it's right here. I need to end this quickly.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Ah...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: ...Watch out! A dangerous presence lurks nearby.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Already? There's no time. Then I'll...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: It's fine, it's fine! At least I get to choose how to die. That alone is great.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Besides, this is just a dream, so it won't hurt that much.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: As for those two mentioned earlier, they were guests we met. They left some items behind, which I've already returned. There's no need to ask anyone else about it.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: This is just my first death. I still have plenty of time to fulfill the promise we made together.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: You should be able to recall at least some of what comes next?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: She hoped to reveal the truth of the dreamscape to you through her own "Death." At the moment she was impaled, even the Emanator of the Nihility would falter, blade wavering in hesitation. That was her way of securing the best of both worlds.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Unfortunately, fate still played a cruel trick on her. The memoria transformed so quickly that she didn't even have a chance to explain.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: After that, she arrived at Dreamflux Reef... land of the exiles, the true Penacony. The Family went to great lengths to conceal its existence, using "Death" as their justification.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: However, at that time she still couldn't venture deeper with peace of mind. Unable to reveal the truth, the situation that had worried her before continued to persist. She was burning with anxiety to return and get you away from the battlefield.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Fortunately, a kind and caring lady was still watching over her. I reached out to help once again.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Her worst fears didn't materialize. "Death" retreated on its own, allowing you all to escape unscathed.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: After that, guided by Black Swan, you tried to uncover the truth behind Firefly's death. However, as you must have noticed, be it losing contact with her companions, or the embarrassment of being unable to activate her mech...
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Those memoria illusions were clearly left behind when she infiltrated Penacony from the Memory Zone. But that hardly matters. Because of Black Swan's blunder, Firefly gained the precious time she needed.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: When she appeared before you again, she was already using a different identity. That encounter stirred the whirlpool of destiny, causing many paths to converge. And after you left...
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: ...Do you still dream, hunter,
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: of those slain by your hand?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ..."My time"?
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: I've seen many clever disguises that can conceal appearances, but they can never cover up who a person really is. And you're no different.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Did Destiny's Slave make you do it?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: You know Elio.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: I thought this is just the kind of thing that'd get written into your "script."
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: My "script" has always been brief. Other than that. Anything beyond that is unnecessary.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: Now, it's my turn to ask: who exactly are you?
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: Why ask when you already know the answer?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I tend to forget things, which is why, rather than memories, I'm accustomed to using my emotions to capture what I normally wouldn't otherwise. So...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...I know who is inside that cold armor.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Therefore, I can sense it. You know who I am, you know this blade, and the... meaning that lies behind it.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: How about it? Ready to take off that armor and sit down for a talk?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It's not yet time.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: You shouldn't know so much, lost Self-Annihilator.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: Like I said... my memory isn't great, so you needn't worry.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: No need for that... No harm in telling you. On Penacony, Elio only gave me one instruction: "Allow the Astral Express to pursue the Grand Legacy."
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: Paradise shall fall into this world of sorrow
And once dawn breaks
It will shatter in the light of day
How could anything golden
Abide in glory forever?

The Astral Express is not your enemy. If your goal is the Watchmaker's Legacy, then go look into The Family. Not only are they covering up the existence of "Death," but they're burying the past and the truth about the dreamscape.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: Already on it.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Before we part ways, let me give you a piece of advice...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: No matter which path you and I walk, {RUBY_B#Nihility}death{RUBY_E#} is the inevitable finale.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Even if we say "farewell" in the mortal realm, we shall have one final reunion when Terminus ascends to godhood once more... and the same holds true on Penacony.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...I've already been to the Dreamflux Reef. It's not a secret that's hard to uncover.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: ...Well, I'm afraid you have yet to realize just how "awake" you truly are.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It is precisely because life dares to slumber that they can awaken.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: "Ascends to godhood once more"... even if {RUBY_B#Acheron}she{RUBY_E#}'s an Emanator, she shouldn't...
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: After today, Jepella's name will disappear from cosmic history, and the Ever-Flame Mansion will take its place. In the not-too-distant future, you'll receive an invitation...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: What feeling?
That's your next stop.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Land of the Dreams, Penacony.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I hope you find whatever you seek there, be it answers... or salvation.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Thanks, I hope...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Huh... a phone call? At a time like this...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: You can turn him down. You know what I mean.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: But Elio said I'm the perfect candidate.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Candidate? So Elio finally came to a conclusion?
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Yes, he said he saw the fourth fate clearly, and there won't be any more surprises. He also chose me as the "Last Survivor," just like [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Which Path is it?
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: The Nihility. After it engulfs everything, I must be the last survivor, giving my all to turn the tide.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: How ruthless.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: However, it's a bit different from the other three. Before that, I have other matters that need my attention.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: "If possible" is a bit vague.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: I suppose, if it comes to that...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Even if I have to die for it, I cannot run away.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: In the "future" that Elio foresaw, we never had an "ending." But I still have a chance... to wrestle back from fate the right to have a "beginning."
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: Your guest room in reality is surprisingly modest...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: It's not necessarily a bad thing. If I really do meet my end, I won't have a chance to tell them the truth anyway. Are they still around?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...An aesthetic you share, Miss Acheron.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: It's a cinch. This music box, the "invitation" received by the Annihilation Gang... There are latent memories that linger on it yet.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: You see, memories of you are not yours alone. They travel in other people... Other things. I know much, and I can predict even more. With some help, the dead can be made to speak.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I left her a message. If she gets it, she'll help guide [Trailblazer] back here.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Or we could head back to reality first and get in touch with Silver Wolf.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Hold on, recklessly crossing through the dreamscape now would be far more dangerous than before.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: ...What's the matter?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: "Death" caused such a huge commotion that the {RUBY_B#"Dreammaster" Gopher Wood}omnipotent being within the sweet dream{RUBY_E#} has turned its gaze upon this place.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Then aren't we...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: We should be fine for now. "Death" has his attention, as long as we are careful, we won't be exposed.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: In fact... within this dreamscape, we might find a way to strike back against him.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Mm-hmm, before you arrived, I did some digging around. From what I've learned, he buried his darkest crimes right here.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Whatever it is, I believe it'll be of some use. Let's go look for it before they come back.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: The Annihilation Gang, that band of desperadoes who all disappeared after meeting you... What exactly happened to them? Well, let me reveal all.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "...Gradation twelve ██ Dreamscape twelve ██ Father ██ I dedicate this to you..."
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: "...Well done ██ Dubra ██ wherever they go, ██ shall be met by annihilation..."
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: ...There it is. It's hazy, but it's Ifrit's voice. The other one... is probably his progeny.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: This is the residual memory from when the 'invitation' was first delivered... they were abruptly interrupted. Then, what happened next is...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "...They sought refuge in the land of sleep ██, merely wishing for undisturbed rest, away from the storms..."
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: "Children of the flame ██ this marks your rite of passage."
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: "She won't be necessary ████ I alone am enough."
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: Shh—████ when have those ██ on the Path of Destruction ██ feared death?
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: The Ever-Flame Mansion has set out on a journey. Those poor people... They have no idea what lies in wait ahead of them.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Memory recovery is going well, but slowly. She'll be here soon, and time is short.... There's nobody else here, so there's no need to be delicate... In fact I think I'd better go all out....
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...What happened?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The memory after that... is blank? How is that possible... This music box fell into Acheron's hands, and she brought it to Penacony. That's a fact, and that's how it should have gone... but along the way...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...It's like it's been erased? Who's done this...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "...Who are you?"
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: No. Is this not a "memory"?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "Oh... a Memokeeper. Do you serve the Garden of Recollection... or The Cremators?"
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: "My name is Constance... A pleasure to meet you. We were supposed to meet in Penacony and spend an... unforgettable time together."
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: "But that seems unrealistic. Dahlia's not welcome on the Banquet Star, and I don't need a coming-of-age ceremony... And you, I know what you're looking for..."
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: "Want {RUBY_B#Acheron}'her'{RUBY_E#} secret? I can give it to you, and then... you can enjoy the banquet for me."
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: "I wish you 'unforgettable' memories."
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: Cut the mystical act. I'm absolutely certain you're not thousands of miles away.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: In that Primordial Memory Zone, my acuity was blocked at every turn. I thought it was because of The Family, but it turns out there was a colleague present. What brings you here?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: My, how aggressive. Are you backed into a corner, or have you figured something out? What could bring Constance of the Ever-Flame Mansion here?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: That's your fatal flaw, mysterious Cremator. The Annihilation Gang has always operated in plain sight, with no secrets among its members. And Duke Inferno has never had an offspring named Constance.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Oh? Are you so sure? What if... I'm just too "capricious" and can't help but betray anyone?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: That's impossible, the Antimatter Legion has been after {RUBY_B#The Dahlia}her{RUBY_E#} this whole time.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Aren't you the same? The Garden of Recollection launched fourteen pursuits trying to erase me, and in that final one, I died right in front of you, didn't I?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: It really is you...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: To interrupt another's reunion... such a graceless act. But by all means...
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: After this, we'll have ourselves a nice long talk about your ingratitude, my dear "cellmate."
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Hm? That's a peculiar look on your face. Before this, I was always anxious about this moment, always afraid you might find me frightening.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: You were involved too?
That's pretty terrifying.
You know Black Swan?
Never mind, let's continue.
Of course, everything about Penacony is more important than you think.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: To prevent other terrible outcomes, the Stellaron Hunters were forced to use great power.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: If you're willing, and if you can endure it... I can keep going. Or perhaps...
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: ...you would prefer to indulge in my "double standards?"
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Yeah, we were quite "close." Don't get the wrong idea from how I phrased it back then.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: I've always thought that when two people are locked in a knife fight, with their blades pressed to each other's throats, they become more intimate than any pair of dancers.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Now, let's turn our gaze to where the threads of destiny intertwine...
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Soon after, you finally learned Black Swan's intentions: She made a deal with the IPC to bring you before Aventurine. In order to reclaim Penacony, the IPC had been seeking temporary allies.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: As a show of initial sincerity, he revealed his discovery to you: The crime scene of "Robin's death" that was staged by the Fool.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: From that moment on, Aventurine embarked upon his great gamble.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Willing to shatter the Cornerstone as precious as life itself, he deceived Sunday with his schemes, earning himself a chance to risk it all.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: With such a high-stakes gamble, he succeeded in provoking the Emanator's strike. The Family's carefully guarded secret was exposed, and you, caught in the eye of the storm, were pulled into the chaos.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: But that's all about the living. In the same moment, what became of those within the world of the "dead?"
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Miss Robin arrived at Dreamflux Reef ahead of you. But what awaited her wasn't the uncertainty of a gamble...
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: But rather a destined life, and a destined death.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Brother, I don't understand... For a bird, does flying... also need a "why"?
rows.speaker: Guileless Girl

rows.text: Since it falls to us to decide whether to release it back to the sky, we must take responsibility for that choice.
rows.speaker: Gloomy Boy

rows.text: That really sounds like Mr. Gopher Wood...
rows.speaker: Guileless Girl

rows.text: But... I've made up my mind.
rows.speaker: Guileless Girl

rows.text: Let it soar free and wild.
rows.speaker: Guileless Girl

rows.text: If I had feathers and wings like it does, I'd definitely want to fly, even if just to try it once.
rows.speaker: Guileless Girl

rows.text: Besides, Big Brother will help it, right?
rows.speaker: Guileless Girl

rows.text: But...
rows.speaker: Gloomy Boy

rows.text: It's truly reassuring to hear such words before parting. Come, Sunday, your little sister will be walking ahead of you now.
rows.speaker: Merciful Ferryman

rows.text: Mr. Gopher Wood? How did you...
rows.speaker: Guileless Girl

rows.text: "11:15█The gods bestowed upon us heavenly fire, and with it divine tribulations. Let them be, for we are all mortals, born to love and to suffer."
rows.speaker: Merciful Ferryman

rows.text: Today, more than one little bird will embark on their long journey. How could I miss the moment of your departure?
rows.speaker: Merciful Ferryman

rows.text: Come here, child. I've prepared a "farewell gift" for you.
rows.speaker: Merciful Ferryman

rows.text: ...What did she give you?
rows.speaker: Micah

rows.text: Miss Robin?
rows.speaker: Micah

rows.text: Sorry, where was I?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: In Dream's Edge, a Masked Fool attacked you and left behind a parting gift.
rows.speaker: Micah

rows.text: Though it's hard to call it a gift. When the Fool killed me, they put a mask on my face.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: But when I woke up in Dreamflux Reef, it was gone, and I couldn't feel any effects from it.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: She might be hinting at something, but I still can't figure out what she means.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Speaking of which, how's that anomaly of yours doing now?
rows.speaker: Micah

rows.text: I'm gradually getting better. There's no denying that Dreamflux Reef also spreads the Harmony, and it hasn't been affected by The Family's traitor.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: As for my loss of voice, I still need to keep investigating. Perhaps I've been wearing a mask all along without even realizing it.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: If you need any help, just say the word.
rows.speaker: Micah

rows.text: Thanks to your help. I'm starting to get familiar with this place.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: But Dreamflux Reef is so isolated... Is there any way to know what's happening outside? I want to check on my brother's situation.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: That's easy! Just head to where all the action is. Want me to show you the way?
rows.speaker: Micah

rows.text: I'll take a walk around by myself, thanks, Mr. Micah.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Oh, and when you're gathering intel, remember to sort fact from fiction. Rumors do pop up from time to time.
rows.speaker: Micah

rows.text: I'll keep that in mind. Thanks for the heads-up.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: ...Miss Robin? Can you hear me?
That voice...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Over here...
Are you... Miss Firefly?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: So you did notice me after all. Sorry, but I can't show myself right now. Could we talk somewhere more private?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: To be honest, I have no reason to trust you.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I get it, but I can assure you this isn't a trap. If you really need a reason...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: There are anomalies in the Twelve Hours. We are suspicious of the Dreammaster's true identity.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Lead the way, but let me be clear: agreeing to meet doesn't imply anything about my stance.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Understood, my companion will show you the way.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (Blue flames... Is there a Cremator among Miss Firefly's companions?)
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: (Where... is this...)
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: As expected of the Harmony's favorite... Passing through such dense memoria without even being affected in the slightest.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Hello, you may call me the Dahlia for now. This is our cozy new home in the sweet dream, where words may flow more freely.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: A new home burned out of the sweet dream? If you really wish to have a proper conversation, you shouldn't resort to provocation like this.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I apologize, but she's different from other Cremators: She has no intention of stealing memories. The same goes for me. I have never wished to destroy the sweet dream. Sneaking into the dream was my only option.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Great, {F#s}he's okay too...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I really like Penacony, as a tourist. This is my first time dreaming, and Penacony is more wonderful than I imagined.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Thanks. So, what brings you here?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I'm sure you've noticed it too.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: The Dreammaster Gopher Wood completely merged with the dreamscape, becoming virtually omniscient and omnipotent in Penacony. But now, he's losing his grip on the dreamscape.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: To find out why, we conducted some investigations. In the Primordial Dreamscape, we uncovered a crime that he had buried away.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: We suspect that's why his powers aren't what they used to be. And that's why he's been telling everyone he's under the weather.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...Crime?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I'll show you later. Belonging to his family, you wouldn't believe me unless you saw it with your own eyes.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: You've indeed uncovered many clues, but before we proceed, I must confirm your true intentions.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Shh... be careful. What's wrong? Right now, their journeying together is actually saving us a lot of trouble.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: My purpose... is about a reunion, a rescue, and a farewell.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: That {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Stellaron is clearly unfamiliar with memoria, and that arrogant swan, always mindful of appearances, is unwilling to show all her cards. Only with Acheron present can they cross beyond death.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Then all the more reason I should find them right now and tell them the truth. There's no need for another conflict with "Death."
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Will you believe me?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Miss Firefly, that expression and tone of yours just now... I've seen it many times in my audience.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: ...Expression?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: That's the look one has when describing what they hold most dear in their heart, so I'll trust you this time.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: When I first left Penacony, the Dreammaster gave me a parting gift... a "divine law", so to speak.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: For a leader of the Five Lineages, that's pretty cheap, isn't it?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Since then, I've walked the Path of Harmony as a Pathstrider, wielding its power.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: ...Until I returned once again for the Charmony Festival.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: In the Twelve Hours converged by the Dreammaster, I developed symptoms of losing my voice, and the strength of the Harmony began to wane. Yet in Dreamflux Reef, I wasn't affected at all.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I believe that the Path he once pointed to might not have been named the Harmony.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: That's why I gradually became incompatible with the sweet dream. In the past, the Dreammaster would harmonize for me, but when he was too busy to tend to me, I finally noticed something was wrong.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: So, which Path did he choose to walk?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: It's not clear yet. There aren't many clues about this, but I suspect it's the Order.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: ...Thank you, Miss Robin. You've helped us clear up many of our doubts. However, regarding the Dreammaster's Path... we have different conjectures.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...What is it?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Come with me. It's time to see it with your own eyes.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Here lies secrets that The Family tried to conceal, and a long, romantic tale. Sadly, most of it has nothing to do with us.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Breukelen Tiernan... I remember that name. A Galaxy Ranger worthy of admiration. When Penacony was plagued by the Swarm Disaster in the past, he was the one who fearlessly protected our sweet dream.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: That's why we had to come here. We suspect that after turning away from The Family, the Dreammaster sided with the Propagation.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...How could that be?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: History as we know it may be long gone, but people's memories remain preserved in the Memory Zone...
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: If we can master the technique, we'll be able to pierce through time itself and salvage the past from chaos.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Is this... memoria?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Every disaster brought by the Swarm was accompanied by countless sacrifices. Some names were remembered, but others... were not only forgotten, but betrayed.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: What... are you doing... I'm not your enemy...
rows.speaker: AR-214

rows.text: Indeed. Our true foe is that abominable fate.
rows.speaker: Dreammaster Gopher Wood

rows.text: Then why... why...
rows.speaker: AR-214

rows.text: Easy, child. Your struggle only adds to the pain.
rows.speaker: Dreammaster Gopher Wood

rows.text: The strike I just delivered — dishonorable though it may be — did not miss. Here and now, your death is certain.
rows.speaker: Dreammaster Gopher Wood

rows.text: But I... I was clearly... helping fight against the Swarm here...
rows.speaker: AR-214

rows.text: Indeed, as the Swarm ran rampant, a Glamoth Knight passing through joined the battle without asking for anything in return... Truly admirable.
rows.speaker: Dreammaster Gopher Wood

rows.text: But have you ever wondered why, right after that, the infestation only grew worse?
rows.speaker: Dreammaster Gopher Wood

rows.text: Could it be...
rows.speaker: AR-214

rows.text: You had no desire to kill [Trailblazer]. You only did what you did to drive me and the Memokeeper away... But why?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: The Glamoth Knight, born to purge the Swarm, turned out to be a Pathstrider walking the Path of Propagation.
rows.speaker: Dreammaster Gopher Wood

rows.text: The sweet dream has never been tainted by the Propagation... You brought it here. And only your death can remove it.
rows.speaker: Dreammaster Gopher Wood

rows.text: How... can this... be...
rows.speaker: AR-214

rows.text: I... can leave, and never... come back here...
rows.speaker: AR-214

rows.text: I can't die... I don't want to die...
rows.speaker: AR-214

rows.text: That's precisely why I said that strike wasn't honorable. I explored your secrets for the sake of the sweet dream, but striking you down? That came from selfish desires after glimpsing eternity.
rows.speaker: Dreammaster Gopher Wood

rows.text: "11:45█Paradise shall fall into this world of sorrow, and once dawn breaks, it will shatter in the light of day. How could anything golden abide in glory forever?"
rows.speaker: Dreammaster Gopher Wood

rows.text: You shall become my darkest crime, and the beginning of a great undertaking.
rows.speaker: Dreammaster Gopher Wood

rows.text: Your {RUBY_B#Path}remains{RUBY_E#} shall become the foundation for "Eternal Paradise."
rows.speaker: Dreammaster Gopher Wood

rows.text: You want me to become the "conduit" to retrieve the "past" from the Memory Zone? What exactly do I need to do?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I'll need to temporarily take a piece of your memory. By letting it stir up the Memory Zone, I can follow the flow of memoria and burn a path through, retrieving scenes from the past once again.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Whether I succeed or not, I'll return your memories to you safe and sound.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Let a Cremator access my memories?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: What's next, then? [Trailblazer]'s been taken by Black Swan. Will you go look for {M#him?}{F#her?}
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I also think it's too much to ask. If you deem it necessary, you can use "Tuning" to leave a safeguard in our minds, preventing any ulterior motives.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: There's no need. Let's get started.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: "May the harm that befalls you never lead to your downfall." This is a blessing that has been passed down through The Family for generations. I don't want all trust to be built upon mutual threats.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: So this is what star power looks like... you've even made me a little star-struck.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Alright. Looks like we got lucky.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Oh? What's this? A piece of worm-eaten oak?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Found something new?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: This time, I'm afraid we've uncovered quite a "disaster." Let's go see it with our own eyes.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Nothing but lies, my dear.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Hiding behind the title of a Memokeeper... Tell me, how long have you been lying to them?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: A distant past resurfaced...
You really seem determined to savor those unforgettable moments, don't you? Be smart and take a hint. I don't have time to entertain you right now.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Oh, because you're busy... pretending to be a Stellaron Hunter?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...Who are you talking about?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Quite the clever move there. Miss Firefly... if you're willing to take my advice, why not make a trip back to reality? Ask that Silver Wolf lady carefully who your true companions really are.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: How did you...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Alright, you... still can't help sticking your nose into everything, huh.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Who... exactly are you people?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: She's... just a Cremator who manipulated memories and pretended to be a Stellaron Hunter's companion. She fooled all of you.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: What about Miss Firefly? Is she alright?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: She might get lost in the Memory Zone's turbulence, but don't worry, she's quite something. She'll only be stuck there temporarily.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I'm here to bring you back to the Oak Family. Mr. Sunday is worried about your safety. He tasked me with finding you in the dreamscape.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: As for this Dahlia, she cannot be trusted. To extract specific history from the Memory Zone through just one memory... While there might be Memokeepers capable of such feats, they certainly wouldn't be mere Pathstriders.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Heh, seems you've been watching for quite a while, yet you only show up "fashionably late" when we're about to make progress... Who's the untrustworthy one here, I wonder?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Save your excuses. I bring a message from Mr. Sunday that will prove my identity.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: If possible, I must prevent [Trailblazer] from being tainted by the power of Nihility, even the slightest trace of it. After all, everything {F#s}he carries is not only heavier, but also more precious.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: ...Just a message? Don't you find that a bit ridiculous?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Let's give it a try. It's only two words...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "Charmony Dove."
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I don't know the details, but Mr. Sunday said you would understand.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...Indeed, unless it's an extreme situation, this is enough to earn my trust.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: The IPC, Astral Express... and now you're even taking assignments from The Family? My, aren't you "popular."
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: ...But you just had to choose the path of your own demise?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Back then, I not only kept Lady Acheron's secret, but also left you with your life intact.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: What, you're that eager to... "rekindle our past"?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Well, you are The Dahlia after all. I have to keep an eye on what kind of trouble you're going to stir up next.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I've been questioning this for a long time... How could Destiny's Slave possibly accept someone like you, whose very nature is betrayal?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: And what's the deal with the Stellaron Hunter?
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Let's get somewhere safe first, then we can talk. She's too dangerous for us to let our guard down.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...Many thanks.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Not long after, at The Reverie Hotel...
You've gotten more "composed," or have you just gotten slower?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Robin}She's{RUBY_E#} already left this area. There's no way you can catch up to her now.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...Catch?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: ...Why would I chase after her? Arrogant swan... if I didn't take her memories just now, then what exactly did I do to her?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: I might as well tell you. I've planted a spark of the Cremators' fire in her memories.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: It will spread silently, and in an instant, it will burn away all her memories of seeing me. She'll believe she was never here.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: The suspicions that have already taken root in her mind will also gradually fade away. No matter what she has discovered, the moment she attends the Charmony Festival, she'll revert back to that... good child who was born to walk on the Order.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: You're the one who's run out of time.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: I see. Not a member of the Ever-Flame Mansion, and definitely not a Stellaron Hunter... Your true ally is the Dreammaster?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Aren't you clever? How about a little "reward" for that?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Cut the act. Even with your usual reckless methods, you can't handle me alone.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: You're right, I can't do it alone... But I rarely feel lonely anyway.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Now, can you still keep your cool?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: He actually gave you strength through the "divine law"? The Dreammaster would go this far for an ally?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: What can I say? I'm just that trustworthy! If he hadn't done that, how could my control over memoria far exceed that of ordinary Memokeepers, let alone... allow me to tamper with {RUBY_B#Firefly}a Stellaron Hunter's{RUBY_E#} memories?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Unfortunately, you lost your composure in your euphoria. In the dreamscape, I might not be your match. But if I want to leave, you can't keep me here.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Harsh words... Want to test that theory? It's easy to throw away a flower, but the fragrance lingering on your hands won't fade so easily. I can be quite persistent, you know.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Even if we rekindle what once was, I remain unchanged.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Run faster, I love watching people resist, love watching them flee. Let's savor this moment a bit longer. After all, for us, this will be an incredibly crucial moment.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: No matter where you run, I will always find you.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: ...Where do you think you're going? After putting on such an elaborate show, won't you stay for a little chat?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Weren't you really interested in the Ever-Flame Mansion?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: So you were the one who erased the memories from that music box after all.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: That's right. I kept only this scene as a memento. I wanted to remember how I felt at that moment.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: And... look closer. It's not just the memories. The Ever-Flame Mansion itself has ceased to exist.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Those claw marks... You've long since strayed from that Path, yet you can still wield the power of the Destruction?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Isn't it the same right now? I've betrayed the Garden of Recollection, yet I can still show you the memories.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: If you have time, I can... help you savor the memory of our first encounter.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Go ahead and savor it on your own. I want to put it behind me, the sooner, the better.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: But can't you tell me something I don't already know? You betrayed the Ever-Flame Mansion... Is that really supposed to be surprising?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Destruction is a glorious moment. As Duke Inferno's "daughter," I will see his last wishes carried out to perfection, even if my role as such is only temporary.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: And besides... who said I betrayed them back then? I came here to fulfill Duke Inferno's last wishes.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: This was his command to me: "Make the nights of Penacony crumble and wither, leave nought but a tomb of Remembrance."
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: In other words, everything on Penacony related to the Remembrance was my target for destruction. But this was already a world of memoria. How could I possibly accomplish this without any help?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Working with the Dreammaster may be like dancing with the devil, but I have no better choice.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Oh yes, everything tied to the Remembrance includes you, of course. Grateful? You should be. My whim is the only reason you're still alive.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: I won't be grateful for that... You couldn't have done it anyway. Filial piety has never been one of your strong suits, so drop the act.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: That's exactly why I'm saying... you only think you understand me. Think about it carefully. As a Stellaron Hunter, didn't I work my hardest to help Firefly get closer to the truth?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: As an ally of the Dreammaster, I also helped monitor the dreamscape, and when {RUBY_B#Firefly}a hunter{RUBY_E#} infiltrated Penacony, I seized the chance to pose as her companion and trapped her in the Memory Zone.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: As for Robin, whom he chose as his songstress, I burned away her doubts too, leaving nothing to chance.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Like the Destruction, "betrayal" is but a fleeting moment. And before it came, whether with Duke Inferno, Gopher Wood, or Firefly... I wasn't pretending. I truly, wholeheartedly "became" their companion.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: What about Robin? Those sparks that burned through memories... don't you think that was a bit too much?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...Oh my, I thought I could fool your eyes at the edge of the Dreamscape. But I guess there's no hiding from you on your home turf.
rows.speaker: Sampo (?)

rows.text: What, you want to settle the score with me for messing with your people? Why don't we sit down and have a chat? You seem like a patient one to me.
rows.speaker: Sampo (?)

rows.text: So, tell me... what exactly do you want to take from me?
rows.speaker: Sampo (?)

rows.text: Don't worry, I only went with the flow... Suppressing her power a little to make it easier for you.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: I trust... you're someone who knows how to return a favor, right?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: There's this thing called the "Script." Now that, I find quite intriguing... Stellaron Hunter collaborator.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Soon, Robin will understand the true purpose of those sparks, and thank me for it.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: I can hardly wait. Even though I'm not a Stellaron Hunter, this time... I might have a chance to "betray destiny," too.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: So stop thinking you've figured me out. I don't want to miss out on any possibility life has to offer.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Betrayal isn't in my nature. "Greed" is.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Darling, are you fatally wounded, or terminally ill? Unless you're on your deathbed, I don't believe you're actually being this honest.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I can make an exception for you. But most people? I certainly don't want them to remember.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Sometimes, I resent memories... Because some people don't deserve to witness my radiant bloom again in their memories.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: And besides, you're no better when it comes to greed. On my deathbed? I suppose that's not entirely wrong... I was hoping a little honesty could talk you into "dying with me."
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: No, thank you.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Too late. You're already caught up in this secret. Come on, just a few steps more. Even if I tried to turn you away, you wouldn't want to.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: I see now... "A piece of worm-eaten oak"... You weren't just making that up.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Oak wood is prone to "insect infestations." Nothing surprising about that.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: It's him...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Just look at this place. It shouldn't be this lively here. Ladies, which one of us would you say is the uninvited guest?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Mr. Aventurine, what are you doing here?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The game's over, and I scored a big win.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Oh? What did you get out of it?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The Nihility Emanator cut me, and I died in the most spectacular fashion.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Oh, speaking of which, you must know exactly how that feels? My dear lady who loves to dance?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Still better than having no invites at all, my dear helpful lady.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Ha, you two are... really something special.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You're quite interesting, Mr. Aventurine. However...
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: You weren't supposed to find your way here. Unless you can give me a reason, I'll indulge you... By letting you die once more.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: That confident, huh?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You haven't hidden your weakness well. Even though you're one of the Ten Stonehearts, right now, you'll be easy enough to handle.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: I wouldn't be so sure. Since you know who I am, you should know better than to gamble. Consider this warning a welcome gift from a friend...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: So long as my "trump card" remains unplayed, none will dare see the hand through to the end.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: "As for that mask of yours... is it really called the Harmony? The Twin of the Order?"
Too bad you've used up all your luck for today. I've always found losing more interesting than winning. What's the harm in giving it a try?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Hold up, no need to rush into making enemies.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Mr. Aventurine, congratulations on uncovering the truth behind "Death," but from what I know, you should be at Dreamflux Reef instead.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Hah, after taking a solid hit from the Emanator's blade, I never got the chance to enjoy a good nap.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Thus I sank into the chaotic Memory Zone, and then, my "desire" led me here.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Hah, as I thought. You two haven't noticed. The answer was right under your noses this whole time. You can traverse through memoria without relying on "roads," which is exactly why you missed it.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Ladies, you didn't think the IPC would enter Penacony unprepared, did you?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Backed by a most attractive package, I quietly assembled a team to research the Memory Zone. And I only asked for one thing in return: How to escape alive if I accidentally got lost in Penacony's memoria.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: To be honest, they didn't contribute a thing, but they did help me discover a certain "legacy"...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Razalina Jane Estella, the former undertaking once belonging to this Nameless.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: She once boarded the Astral Express as an outstanding Surveyor. Years ago, in pursuit of the Primordial Dreamscape's secrets, she ventured alone into the Memory Zone and was never seen again.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Everyone believed she had perished, taking the mysteries of the Dreamscape to her grave. But that wasn't the truth.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Before departing from this world, she single-handedly forged the "pathway of memoria."
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Mr. Aventurine, do you even realize what you're saying?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Look, I didn't believe it at first either. But the Nameless, as it happens, had quite a unique background that led her to devise a brilliant solution.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Using the technology from the Zorina-Urd system, she gave her life to the Memory Zone, giving Penacony's Dreamscape a "unique signature."
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: When Dreamchasers wander into the Memory Zone, they'll drift towards places that can fulfill their "desires."
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Those who yearn for freedom will witness the form of the Primordial Dreamscape, those consumed by obsession might encounter certain special dream bubbles.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: And those who are "lost and directionless" will return to the Twelve Hours, seeking their path within their own past.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: The Family discovered this trait and cleverly utilized it, allowing guests to be sent to different Hours upon their first dream entry.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: In other words, this Nameless is the true founder of the Planet of Festivities.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: As for me... Ha, maybe I ran into a "good doctor." From the look of this place, he's the one who let me blunder my way in.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Looks like I'm pretty lucky! I can't wait to see what I'll discover here.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: It would seem luck favors you still, Mr. Aventurine.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Fate is truly... fascinating yet cruel.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Remember Miss Robin's question? If the Dreammaster was after the Propagation, why did he have to harm the Glamoth Knight?
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Years ago, he had already completed this plan, waiting for a Glamoth Knight to enter the dream. Unfortunately, with the sudden fall of his empire, his hopes seemed to have been dashed.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Yet just as the Charmony Festival was about to begin, a descendant of the Glamoth Knights appeared uninvited, and everything began to turn once again.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: The Dreammaster was never afraid of Firefly investigating the Propagation. That was exactly the {RUBY_B#façade}truth{RUBY_E#} he wanted her to see.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Wait, is that why you trapped her in the Memory Zone?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Correct. This place... is where the Dreammaster wanted her to be. And he wanted her to think she'd figured something out, only to make the wrong decision at the most critical moment.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: So what exactly is the Dreammaster plotting?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: It doesn't matter anymore. We've missed our chance to stop him.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: ...Even if we catch him in person?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: From the very beginning, he never existed "anywhere" at all.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: When he attempted to merge with the Dreamscape, he transformed himself into four Primordial Divine Laws.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: "11:15█The gods bestowed upon us heavenly fire, and with it divine tribulations. Let them be, for we are all mortals, born to love and to suffer."
rows.speaker: Echo of "Divine Law (I)"

rows.text: The First Law... As his parting gift, he bestowed it upon Robin, guiding her onto the Harmony.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: "11:30█Repent and return to righteousness. Though you soar like an eagle and make your nest among the stars, I will bring you down from there."
rows.speaker: Echo of "Divine Law (II)"

rows.text: The Second Law is the power he bestowed upon me as his collaborator. At the same time, it serves as a constraint to ensure I won't act recklessly.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: And the Third Law...
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: "11:45█Paradise shall fall into this world of sorrow, and once dawn breaks, it will shatter in the light of day. How could anything golden abide in glory forever?"
rows.speaker: Echo of "Divine Law (III)"

rows.text: I haven't seen it myself either. According to him, it was an all-out attack, like a torrent of fire pouring down from above.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: And the last one?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Nobody knows. After claiming to be ill and withdrawing from public view, even though the constraint remained in place, he never contacted anyone again. Not even me, his collaborator.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: It's just my theory, but I'm pretty sure I'm right. By then he had finally completed the last "law" and used it to eliminate the one weakness that exists in any plan... the mastermind himself.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: The moment the plan was set in motion, Gopher Wood died a martyr's death for the {RUBY_B#the Order}just cause{RUBY_E#} he believed in.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: And the Swarm Disaster shall reappear again in the sweet dream.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: The moment has finally come. Resentful from being deceived, confused by conflicting memories... Your expression right now is so similar to what I had imagined.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia

rows.text: Whose side are you really on?
Every side. I'll try to fulfill Duke Inferno's last wishes, advance Gopher Wood's plans, and yes, indeed, I've helped the Stellaron Hunters uncover the truth.
rows.speaker: The Dahlia
